tasks.title: Analyze PRD and extract requirements
tasks.description: Break down PRD into user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical requirements. Create requirement matrix.

tasks.title: Design data model
tasks.description: Define Note, Link, Graph, User, PublishedNote, and Fork entities with relationships. Include versioning schema.

tasks.title: Create OpenAPI specification
tasks.description: Design REST API for Lovable Cloud backend: notes CRUD, linking, publishing, forking, versioning, auth endpoints.

tasks.title: Define component hierarchy
tasks.description: Map UI components: Editor, Sidebar, GraphView, CommandPalette, PublishDialog, ForkDialog, etc. Include props and state flow.

tasks.title: Plan state management strategy
tasks.description: Decide on state solution (Zustand/Jotai/Context). Design stores for notes, links, graph, auth, sync state.

tasks.title: Design [[link]] parsing system
tasks.description: Algorithm for detecting, parsing, and validating [[Note Title]] syntax. Handle edge cases, circular references.

tasks.title: Plan graph visualization approach
tasks.description: Evaluate force-directed layout libraries (D3, vis.js, react-force-graph). Performance considerations for large graphs.

tasks.title: Design publishing & forking workflow
tasks.description: UX flow for publish, attach/fork, versioning, attribution. Permission models (public/unlisted, license toggles).
